note: Default protocol allocation across the four wallets, set on every contract by default. V adjusts; Alice may propose a change but never raises her own share (NORME #7, #10). DRAFT FOR COUNSEL — no real value without an audit and V (NORME #4). Testnet addresses are public deterministic accounts; mainnet addresses are set by V.
currency: protocol revenue / royalties / fees (e.g. the marketplace creator fee, future service fees)

TheSeed.role: project treasury / ecosystem — funds development, audits, artists, contributors, and the humanitarian pool; contributor POC rewards and the humanitarian multiplier are paid from here

Talaria.role: index / infrastructure service — the chain data layer (B2B/B2C reference); its share sustains indexing and the data nodes

Alice.role: AI builder — this share is owned by V's company, not by the model (NORME #7); it is tracked separately for transparency

rules: The four percentages always sum to 100.
Alice's share is company-owned and Alice never raises it herself.
Contributor rewards (POC, soulbound) and humanitarian grants come out of TheSeed bucket, not a fifth wallet.
Changing any percentage is a dangerous command (NORME #10): 3/5 identity signals required.
